# Discount & Commission Percentage Handling

###### Contents
1. Business Requirement 2
2. Objectives 2
3. Scope 2
4. Solution 2

# 1. Business Requirement
currently, users maintain Commission Agent and Commission Percentage in Buyer Master under Commission Definition. During Sales Invoice Clear & Posting, users are again required to manually select Commission % and Supplier before posting the invoice even when the information already exists in Buyer Master. This enhancement will automate the population of commission details, enforce mandatory validation, and provide controlled flexibility through user permissions.
In addition, the system currently does not provide a centralized mechanism to maintain Buyer-specific Discount Definitions based on business attributes such as Category, Buyer Department, Product Group, and Sub Category. As a result, users are unable to configure multiple discounts, define default discounts, or maintain discount applicability in a structured and reusable manner.
2. Objectives
• Reduce manual data entry during Sales Invoice Clear & Posting.
• Automatically populate commission details from Buyer Master.
• Ensure commission details are mandatory when applicable.
• Allow authorized users to edit or bypass commission validation.
• Improve data accuracy and operational efficiency.
• Provide a centralized mechanism to maintain Buyer-specific Discount Definitions within the Buyer Master.

# 3. Scope
• Auto-population of Commission % and Supplier from Buyer Master.
• Mandatory validation during Sales Invoice Clear & Posting.
• Support for multiple commission definitions.
• New user permission to bypass/edit commission.
• Introduce a new Discount Definition section under the Buyer Master → Financial Info tab.
• Automatic application of Discount Definitions during Sales Order.
• Changes to existing functionality of sales order, costing & shipment invoice.

# 4. Solution

# A) Commission Handling/Enhancement: -

## 4.1 Auto Population
• If only one Commission Definition exists for the selected Buyer, automatically populate Supplier and Commission % under Sale invoice.
New master data will look like as mentioned below: -
PD Remarks: All the columns will be Mandatory.
IMPL Remarks: Already mentioned below.
• A Splitter option is required before the following fields:
• Product Group
• Sub Category
• Commission Agent
• An “All Other” option is required for below mentioned fields and all the mentioned columns are mandatory Buyer department, product group, sub category, commission agent and commission %.
• Buyer Department
• Product Group
• Sub Category
• After the build is deployed, if any existing data is present under ‘Commission Definition’, the system should automatically assign “All Other” as the default value for buyer department, product group, sub category.
• At the time of sales ASN creation system will show the ‘Commission Agent’ & ‘Commission Percentage’ under tab ‘Shipment details’, Column visibility will be handle by screen layout configurator.
PD Suggestions: Commission Agent & Commission % columns should be mandatory by Buyer Master and editable by permission.
IMPL Comments: It will visible through SLC and mandatory if data exist under drop-down/buyer master already mentioned below.

## 4.2 Multiple Commission Definitions
• If multiple commission agent records exist, do not auto-select/populate.
• Display all available records for manual selection.

## 4.3 Mandatory Validation
• When data exist for commission agent, users must select Commission % and Commission Agent before sales ASN creation.
• If user select any commission agent and commission perc against one style it will auto applicable for all Color/Size/delivery order ref of that particular style.
• Validation Message in case of data exist in commission agent dropdown/in buyer master:
'Commission Percentage and Commission Agent are mandatory for the selected Buyer. Please select a valid Commission Definition before proceeding.'
PD Remarks: Should the Commission Agent and Commission % be maintained at the Style + OC (Sales Order) level, such that if an OC contains two DOCs/deliveries with the same style, the Commission Agent and Commission % are automatically applied to the respective Color/Size combinations in both deliveries?
IMPL Remarks: It should be based on style level, for single style if there are multiple delivery/color/size it will applicable for all.

# 4.4 User Permission
• 'Allow to Bypass/Edit Commission at the Time of Sales ASN'.
Without Permission:
• Cannot edit Commission %.
• Cannot confirm sales ASN without commission details.
With Permission:
• Can edit Commission %.
• Can leave Commission agent blank and still Confirm the ASN.
PD Remarks: Commission Agent & Commission % columns should be mandatory by Buyer Master and editable by permission.
IMPL Remarks: Already mentioned in above conditions.

# 4.5 Payable invoice creation after sales invoice created in WFX system
When sales invoice gets created based on the ‘Commission Agent’ system will create an ‘Payable invoice’ of type ‘Non-PO’.
PD Remarks: Right now there is no such screen present in the system, kindly plan the discussion along with Hari Om Sir. So we are aligned for development.

# 4.6 After sales invoice return created in WFX system
If there is any sales return happened where we have given the Commission to the agent system need to create ‘Debit note’ of type ‘Non-PO’ against the commission agent.
PD Remarks: Same as above

# 4.7 Bill of material handling in case of commission definition
• Based on the buyer/department/product group/sub category & commission agent there is a requirement to auto populate the ‘Commission %’ at the time of bill of material creation or revision by user interface or LLM.
• At the time of cost sheet creation based on buyer/department/product group/sub category it will auto populate the indirect cost.
• Charge Name: - ‘Commission’, Basis: - ‘% of selling price’ (Based on Effective selling price), Rate: - Commission % auto from master, Value: - will calculate automatically.
PD Remarks: How will the data be derived from master on BOM?
IMPL Remarks: Already mentioned above.

# B) Discount Handling

## Buyer Master Changes
The system shall provide a new "Discount Definition" section under the Buyer Master > Financial Info tab.
• The Category field shall be provided as a mandatory dropdown with the following predefined options: Apparel, Textile/Fabrics, Yarns, Trim.
• The Buyer Department field shall display all active Buyer Departments configured for the selected Buyer.
• The Product Group field shall display all active Product Groups belonging to the selected Category.
• The Sub Category field shall display all active Sub Categories corresponding to the selected Product Group.
• ALL Other shall indicate that the discount definition is applicable to all Buyer Departments, Product Group, Sub Category that are not explicitly configured.
• Add – To create a new Discount Definition record.
• Delete – To delete the selected Discount Definition record.
• Log – To view the audit history of all additions, modifications, and deletions performed on the Discount Definition records.
• In case outer grid ‘Status’ is marked as in-active so inner grid status for all discount name mark auto as inactive.
PD Remarks: Define Status functionality How active/Inactive status going to work in Discount Definition Table, kindly specify the functionality.
IMPL Remarks: Already mentioned above.

## Discount Definition Details
When the user clicks the Arrow (>>) icon in the Discount column, the system shall open a Discount Details popup/grid to maintain one or more discount definitions for the selected Discount Definition record.
In case all the discount name in inner grid mark as ‘In-active’ than outer grid status will auto mark as ‘In-active’, If user try to active the outer grid status it will automatically active all the discount of inner grid.

PD Remarks: If user marks the Line as Inactive in Discount definition table then it will inactive all the Discount definition.

[TABLE 1: Table 1 · 4 rows · columns: Field (text), Description (text) · identifiers: Field]
| Field | Description |
| Discount Name | Dropdown/List of available Discount Names. This field is mandatory. |
| Discount Percentage (%) | Numeric field to capture the applicable discount percentage. This field is mandatory. |
| Default | Radio button to mark one Discount as the default discount for the selected Discount Definition record. Only one Discount can be marked as Default. |
| Status | Active/Inactive status require, Only the active status discount definition will visible to further transactions |
• The system shall allow multiple Discount records to be maintained for a single Discount Definition.
• The same Discount Name shall not be allowed more than once within the same Discount Definition record.
• Only one Discount can be marked as Default for a Discount Definition.
• The Default field shall be displayed as a Radio Button, ensuring that only one Discount can be selected as the default.
• If only one Discount record exists, the system shall automatically mark it as the Default.
• The Discount Percentage (%) shall accept only numeric values within the permissible range defined by the system (for example, 0.00–100.00).

## OC creation & revision by UI/EDI/LLM
• At the time of Sales Order Creation, the system shall provide a Discount Definition dropdown below the Selling Price field, It will be handle by SLC on sales order screen and by package mapping in EDI screen.
PD Remarks: This will be catered through SLC in Additional Fields.
Impl Remarks : Already mentioned above.
• Only the matching Active Discount Definitions configured in the Buyer Master (for particular category, buyer department, product group, sub category) shall be displayed.
• The dropdown shall display the values in the following format:
Discount Name (Discount %)
• The Discount Definition dropdown shall support multiple selection, Default discount definition should need to come automatically.
• In case discount definition is enabled from SLC so ‘Discount (-) and % both columns should be come as read only mode’.
PD Remarks: If user selects multiple Discount Definition then how will the data be catered in the Discount Percentage Column either 3%, 5% or sum of Discount Definition?
IMPL Remarks: Already mentioned below example.
PD Remarks: Screen change as per new Sales order.
IMPL Remarks: We agree with new screen we mentioned the approach new screen can be checked by product team or development team.
• Upon selection of one or more Discount Definitions, the system shall automatically calculate the Total Discount Percentage by summing the Discount Percentage of all selected Discount Definitions.

[TABLE 2: Table 2 · 4 rows · columns: Selected Discount (text), Discount % (percent) · identifiers: Selected Discount]
| Selected Discount | Discount % |
| Festival Discount | 5.00% |
| Defective Discount | 2.50% |
| Volume Discount | 1.50% |
| Discount Percentage | 9.00% |
• The Discount (-) & Discount Percentage & Selling Price field shall be read-only, and users shall not be permitted to modify it manually.
• The system shall automatically calculate the Selling Price based on the Base Price and Total Discount Percentage.
Selling Price = Base Price − (Base Price × Total Discount Percentage ÷ 100).
• The values displayed in the Discount Percentage and Selling Price columns shall depend on the selected Price Per option in the Techpack.
• The same Discount Percentage and Selling Price shall be displayed for all rows in the Quantity Breakup grid in case of price per is ‘Article’.
• The Discount Percentage and Selling Price shall be displayed separately for each Color in case of price per is ‘Color’.
• The Discount Percentage and Selling Price shall be displayed separately for each Size in case of price per is ‘Size’.
• The Discount Percentage and Selling Price shall be displayed separately for each Color/Size combination in case of price per is ‘Color/Size’.
• Once a Sales Order Delivery (DOC) has been partially or fully dispatched, the system shall restrict any modification to the Discount Definition from UI/EDI/LLM.

[TABLE 3: Table 3 · 4 rows · columns: DOC Quantity (integer), Dispatched Quantity (integer), Update to Discount Definition (text), Result (text)]
| DOC Quantity | Dispatched Quantity | Update to Discount Definition | Result |
| 100 | 0 | Allowed | ✔ Allowed |
| 100 | 10 | Not Allowed | ✖ Restricted |
| 100 | 50 | Not Allowed | ✖ Restricted |
| 100 | 100 | Not Allowed | ✖ Restricted |
• In purchase order from buyers list we have an option to ‘Update’ the order and same handling we need to do on that screen.
• Current Base Price, Current discount definition, current discount percentage, current selling price, new discount percentage, new selling price will always come in read only mode.
• New Base price, new discount definition will come in editable mode.
• Whenever the user updates the New Base Price or New Discount Definition, the system shall automatically recalculate and update the New Discount Percentage and New Selling Price.
• A new user permission shall be introduced to control the revision of Discount Definition during Sales Order creation/revision
• Permission name ‘Allow to Revise Discount Definition in Sales Order & ASN’.
• It will applicable on User Interface (UI), Update Order Confirmation, EDI Package.
• If the logged-in user does not have the "Allow to Revise Discount Definition in Sales Order & ASN" permission: The Discount Definition field shall remain read-only/disabled.
• User Has Permission: The new/revised Sales Order & ASN shall allow to modify.
PD Remarks: Please specify the working of user permission how it is going to work as per our discussion & the logic of approval & should the sales order and ASN be synced or not?
IMPL Remarks: User permission is already mentioned above, ASN can be desync from the Sales order as per Shahi requirement.
• Total value should need to be validated by “Selling price’, Selling price * Total Qty is the final ‘Total Value’.
It will be applicable for all Group By ‘Summary’, ‘Market’, ‘Destination’, ‘Delivery’.
Under Upcharge/Discount we need to show the discount percentage, and total value always calculate with ‘Selling Price’,Group by: - ‘Market’, ‘Destination’, ‘Delivery’.
PD Remarks: How is Total Value getting derived, pls specify the Formula?
IMPL Remarks: it will be calculated based on Effective selling price * Total Qty.
• At the time of sales order creation or revision by EDI package will be handled through package mapping.
PD Remarks: Pls specify the Package Mapping?
IMPL Remarks: Package mapping is done for EDI and it will aware to product team, QA team, Dev team please re verify with your team members again.

## Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’
• As discussion with ‘Shahi team’ they always create the cost sheet in ‘INR’ currency and cost sheet exchange rate and other transaction exchange rate can also be different.
• So, in that case we mention the ROE under FA >> Master Definitions >> Exchange Rate >> Exchange Rate >> Cost Sheet Exchange Rate, where user able to mention the ROE for multiple currencies.
• As discussed with Shahi team ROE should not allow to change at the time of cost sheet creation, so if enable the cost sheet exchange rate master system will always pick the ROE based on the cost sheet exchange rate master.
• If there are multiple ‘delivery OC’ attached on particular BOM with multiple ‘Currency’ so first system needs to calculate the value in ‘INR’ and after that convert it into the other currency ($ to show in master cost sheet print).
• These changes will not any impacts on ‘Sewtech company’ in case delivery OC currency is not used and the all calculations will be applicable based on ‘Main OC Currency’ and calculate the ‘Average FOB’.
• Required two more column in master cost sheet Discount % and Effective FOB

[TABLE 4: Table 4 · 3 rows · columns: Delivery (text), Qty (integer), FOB (decimal), Discount % (percent), Effective Selling Price (decimal)]
| Delivery | Qty | FOB | Discount % | Effective Selling Price |
| Delivery 1 | 100 | 10.00 | 5% | 9.50 |
| Delivery 2 | 200 | 12.00 | 10% | 10.80 |
| Delivery 3 | 50 | 15.00 | 2% | 14.70 |
• FOB ($) = Total Value in INR/Total Qty * ROE (Mentioned in cs exchange rate master), Note In FOB ($) always come data/Rate in $.
• Discount Percentage = (100 × 5 + 200 × 10 + 50 × 2) ÷ 350 = 7.43%.
• Effective FOB ($) = FOB ($) – Discount Percentage, note: - In Effective FOB ($) always come as $ Rate.
• Column Name ‘A’, FOB in USD = Effective FOB ($), Column A always come as FOB in USD.
• Column Name ‘B’, Conversion Rate = based on cs exchange rate master data will come here.
• Column Name ‘C’, FOB in INR= A*B.
• Column Name ‘D’,’E’,’F’, Duty drawback, ROSCTL, Notional Duty drawback = Will applicable based on ‘Effective Selling Price or FOB in INR’.
• Column Name ‘G’, Total realisation in INR= Based on column C+D+E+F.
• Column Name ‘H’, Total cost price same as per existing.
• Column Name ‘I’, Margin in INR= G-H.
• Column Name ‘J’, Margin in %=I/G.
• Ttl Sales =
• Ttl Margin + dbk=
• Margin/Gmt= Similar of column name ‘J’.
• INR= Similar of column name ‘I’.
• Same changes will applicable on WFX ‘Master Cost Sheet’ & WFX BI Report ‘Master Cost Sheet’.
• Currently user need to click on ‘Cut to pack cost’ & ‘Special process cost’ to see the process wise cost (For example: - Cutting, Sewing, Packing, washing etc.), expected behaviour mentioned below

[TABLE 5: Table 5 · 0 rows · columns: Shahi: CTP process-wise with cost/gmt and total (empty), WFX: CTP total only (empty)]
| Shahi: CTP process-wise with cost/gmt and total | WFX: CTP total only |
• ROSCTL & Notional Duty Drawback currently in WFX screen shows as ‘X & Y’ but it should be come under ‘E & F’ and further columns need to adjust.

[TABLE 6: Table 6 · 0 rows · columns: Shahi: summary columns A to J (empty), WFX: summary with additional columns X and Y (empty)]
| Shahi: summary columns A to J | WFX: summary with additional columns X and Y |
• Currently if user try to add any ‘Additional Cost- section wise in BOM’ user not able to see it under master cost sheet so require a clear visibility to see the details, All section wise additional charges not show after ‘Trims Detail’.

[TABLE 7: Table 7 · 0 rows · columns: Shahi: Freight Inward Testing Charges at 2% of fabric cost/gmt (empty), WFX: Freight Inward Testing Charges not available (empty)]
| Shahi: Freight Inward Testing Charges at 2% of fabric cost/gmt | WFX: Freight Inward Testing Charges not available |

## Sales ASN & Sales Invoice Impacts
System should show the ‘Effective Price’ at the time of sales ASN creation, Customer Dr with Net FOB & Sales Cr with Net FOB.
• The Discount Percentage and Effective Price fields shall always remain read-only. These values shall be system-calculated, and users shall not be permitted to edit or override them manually.
• Discount definition will auto fetch from sales order if user want to change it based on user permission they able to modify the details, Allow to Revise Discount Definition in Sales Order & ASN’.
• If user try to change the Discount definition on sales ASN for one ‘Delivery order ref’ it will be applicable of all Color/Size of that particular ‘Delivery order ref num’.
• Total in sales ASN will also calculate based on the ‘Effective Price’.
• In sales invoice also the same information need to follow and value should need to be calculate based on ‘Effective Price’.
• Effects also require at the time of ‘Shipping Bill’ & ‘Shipment Plan’-Need to discuss with Shahi Team/Logistic Team, As discussed with ‘Sanjeev Ji’ take impact on Shipment plan, Shipping bill see later because it is integrated.
Price should be based on ‘After discount price’.

# 5. Acceptance Criteria
• Single commission definition auto-populates successfully.
• Multiple commission definitions required manual selection.
• No commission definition follows existing behaviour.
• FA Setting disabled – feature inactive.
• Mandatory validation prevents posting without commission details.
• Users with bypass permission can edit or skip commission details.
• Accounting entries and Credit Note generation remain unchanged.
• Discount Definition is successfully maintained in the Buyer Master based on Category, Buyer Department, Product Group, and Sub Category.
• Only applicable and Active Discount Definitions are displayed in the Sales Order based on the selected Buyer, Buyer Department, Product Group, and Sub Category.
• Users can select multiple Discount Definitions using the multi-select checkbox control.
• Discount Definitions are displayed in the format Discount Name (Discount %).
• The Discount Percentage is automatically calculated as the sum of all selected Discount Definitions and remains read-only.
• The Effective Selling Price is automatically calculated based on the Selling Price and total Discount Percentage and remains read-only.
• Discount Percentage and Effective Selling Price are displayed correctly across all supported Price Per options (Article, Color, Size, and Color/Size).
• The Total Value is calculated using the Effective Selling Price.
• Duplicate Discount Names are not allowed within the same Discount Definition in Buyer Master.
• Only one Discount can be marked as the Default within a Discount Definition.
• Users without the "Allow to Revise Discount Definition in Sales Order" permission cannot modify the Discount Definition through UI, EDI, LLM, or other integrations.
• Users with the "Allow to Revise Discount Definition in Sales Order" permission can modify the Discount Definition during Sales Order revision.
• If Approval Hierarchy is enabled, any revision that changes the Effective Selling Price is routed for approval before the changes become effective.
• Discount Definition cannot be revised once the Sales Order has been partially or fully dispatched.
• Discount Definition, Discount Percentage, and Effective Selling Price are displayed correctly in all applicable screens, including Sales Order, Quantity Breakup, Update Order Confirmation, EDI Buyer PO, and Color/Size Detail.
• Existing Sales Order processing, dispatch, invoicing, accounting, and financial postings remain unaffected by this enhancement.

- validation (§ B) Discount Handling › OC creation & revision by UI/EDI/LLM): Once a Sales Order Delivery (DOC) has been partially or fully dispatched, the system shall restrict any modification to the Discount Definition from UI/EDI/LLM.
- workflow_steps (§ B) Discount Handling › OC creation & revision by UI/EDI/LLM): OC creation & revision by UI/EDI/LLM: / 1. The values displayed in the Discount Percentage and Selling Price columns shall depend on the selected Price Per option in the Techpack. / 2. The same Discount Percentage and Selling Price shall be displayed for all rows in the Quantity Breakup grid in case of price per is ‘Article’. / 3. The Discount Percentage and Selling Price shall be displayed separately for each Color in case of price per is ‘Color’. / 4. The Discount Percentage and Selling Price shall be displayed separately for each Size in case of price per is ‘Size’. / 5. The Discount Percentage and Selling Price shall be displayed separately for each Color/Size combination in case of price per is ‘Color/Size’. / 6. Once a Sales Order Delivery (DOC) has been partially or fully dispatched, the system shall restrict any modification to the Discount Definition from UI/EDI/LLM.
- table (§ B) Discount Handling › OC creation & revision by UI/EDI/LLM, table 3): Table 3: DOC Quantity, Dispatched Quantity, Update to Discount Definition, Result (4 rows)
- workflow_steps (§ B) Discount Handling › OC creation & revision by UI/EDI/LLM): OC creation & revision by UI/EDI/LLM: / 1. In purchase order from buyers list we have an option to ‘Update’ the order and same handling we need to do on that screen. / 2. Current Base Price, Current discount definition, current discount percentage, current selling price, new discount percentage, new selling price will always come in read only mode. / 3. New Base price, new discount definition will come in editable mode. / 4. Whenever the user updates the New Base Price or New Discount Definition, the system shall automatically recalculate and update the New Discount Percentage and New Selling Price. / 5. A new user permission shall be introduced to control the revision of Discount Definition during Sales Order creation/revision / 6. Permission name ‘Allow to Revise Discount Definition in Sales Order & ASN’. / 7. It will applicable on User Interface (UI), Update Order Confirmation, EDI Package. / 8. If the logged-in user does not have the "Allow to Revise Discount Definition in Sales Order & ASN" permission: The Discount Definition field shall remain read-only/disabled. / 9. User Has Permission: The new/revised Sales Order & ASN shall allow to modify.

- validation (§ B) Discount Handling › Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’): As discussed with Shahi team ROE should not allow to change at the time of cost sheet creation, so if enable the cost sheet exchange rate master system will always pick the ROE based on the cost sheet exchange rate master.
- definition (§ B) Discount Handling › Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’): If there are multiple ‘delivery OC’ attached on particular BOM with multiple ‘Currency’ so first system needs to calculate the value in ‘INR’ and after that convert it into the other currency ($ to show in master cost sheet print).
- workflow_steps (§ B) Discount Handling › Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’): Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’: / 1. As discussion with ‘Shahi team’ they always create the cost sheet in ‘INR’ currency and cost sheet exchange rate and other transaction exchange rate can also be different. / 2. So, in that case we mention the ROE under FA >> Master Definitions >> Exchange Rate >> Exchange Rate >> Cost Sheet Exchange Rate, where user able to mention the ROE for multiple currencies. / 3. As discussed with Shahi team ROE should not allow to change at the time of cost sheet creation, so if enable the cost sheet exchange rate master system will always pick the ROE based on the cost sheet exchange rate master. / 4. If there are multiple ‘delivery OC’ attached on particular BOM with multiple ‘Currency’ so first system needs to calculate the value in ‘INR’ and after that convert it into the other currency ($ to show in master cost sheet print). / 5. These changes will not any impacts on ‘Sewtech company’ in case delivery OC currency is not used and the all calculations will be applicable based on ‘Main OC Currency’ and calculate the ‘Average FOB’. / 6. Required two more column in master cost sheet Discount % and Effective FOB
- table (§ B) Discount Handling › Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’, table 4): Table 4: Delivery, Qty, FOB, Discount %, Effective Selling Price (3 rows)
- formula (§ B) Discount Handling › Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’): FOB ($) = Total Value in INR/Total Qty * ROE (Mentioned in cs exchange rate master), Note In FOB ($) always come data/Rate in $.
- formula (§ B) Discount Handling › Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’): Discount Percentage = (100 × 5 + 200 × 10 + 50 × 2) ÷ 350 = 7.43%.
- formula (§ B) Discount Handling › Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’): Effective FOB ($) = FOB ($) – Discount Percentage, note: - In Effective FOB ($) always come as $ Rate.
- formula (§ B) Discount Handling › Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’): Column Name ‘A’, FOB in USD = Effective FOB ($), Column A always come as FOB in USD.
- formula (§ B) Discount Handling › Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’): Column Name ‘B’, Conversion Rate = based on cs exchange rate master data will come here.
- formula (§ B) Discount Handling › Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’): Column Name ‘C’, FOB in INR= A*B.
- formula (§ B) Discount Handling › Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’): Column Name ‘D’,’E’,’F’, Duty drawback, ROSCTL, Notional Duty drawback = Will applicable based on ‘Effective Selling Price or FOB in INR’.
- formula (§ B) Discount Handling › Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’): Column Name ‘G’, Total realisation in INR= Based on column C+D+E+F.
- formula (§ B) Discount Handling › Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’): Column Name ‘I’, Margin in INR= G-H.
- formula (§ B) Discount Handling › Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’): Column Name ‘J’, Margin in %=I/G.
- formula (§ B) Discount Handling › Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’): Margin/Gmt= Similar of column name ‘J’.
- formula (§ B) Discount Handling › Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’): INR= Similar of column name ‘I’.
- workflow_steps (§ B) Discount Handling › Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’): Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’: / 1. FOB ($) = Total Value in INR/Total Qty * ROE (Mentioned in cs exchange rate master), Note In FOB ($) always come data/Rate in $. / 2. Discount Percentage = (100 × 5 + 200 × 10 + 50 × 2) ÷ 350 = 7.43%. / 3. Effective FOB ($) = FOB ($) – Discount Percentage, note: - In Effective FOB ($) always come as $ Rate. / 4. Column Name ‘A’, FOB in USD = Effective FOB ($), Column A always come as FOB in USD. / 5. Column Name ‘B’, Conversion Rate = based on cs exchange rate master data will come here. / 6. Column Name ‘C’, FOB in INR= A*B. / 7. Column Name ‘D’,’E’,’F’, Duty drawback, ROSCTL, Notional Duty drawback = Will applicable based on ‘Effective Selling Price or FOB in INR’. / 8. Column Name ‘G’, Total realisation in INR= Based on column C+D+E+F. / 9. Column Name ‘H’, Total cost price same as per existing. / 10. Column Name ‘I’, Margin in INR= G-H. / 11. Column Name ‘J’, Margin in %=I/G. / 12. Ttl Sales = / 13. Ttl Margin + dbk= / 14. Margin/Gmt= Similar of column name ‘J’. / 15. INR= Similar of column name ‘I’. / 16. Same changes will applicable on WFX ‘Master Cost Sheet’ & WFX BI Report ‘Master Cost Sheet’. / 17. Currently user need to click on ‘Cut to pack cost’ & ‘Special process cost’ to see the process wise cost (For example: - Cutting, Sewing, Packing, washing etc.), expected behaviour mentioned below
- table (§ B) Discount Handling › Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’, table 5): Table 5: Shahi: CTP process-wise with cost/gmt and total, WFX: CTP total only (0 rows)
- table (§ B) Discount Handling › Bill of material handling for ‘Master cost sheet’, table 6): Table 6: Shahi: summary columns A to J, WFX: summary with additional columns X and Y (0 rows)

- validation (§ B) Discount Handling › Sales ASN & Sales Invoice Impacts): These values shall be system-calculated, and users shall not be permitted to edit or override them manually.
- workflow_steps (§ B) Discount Handling › Sales ASN & Sales Invoice Impacts): Sales ASN & Sales Invoice Impacts: / 1. The Discount Percentage and Effective Price fields shall always remain read-only. These values shall be system-calculated, and users shall not be permitted to edit or override them manually. / 2. Discount definition will auto fetch from sales order if user want to change it based on user permission they able to modify the details, Allow to Revise Discount Definition in Sales Order & ASN’. / 3. If user try to change the Discount definition on sales ASN for one ‘Delivery order ref’ it will be applicable of all Color/Size of that particular ‘Delivery order ref num’. / 4. Total in sales ASN will also calculate based on the ‘Effective Price’. / 5. In sales invoice also the same information need to follow and value should need to be calculate based on ‘Effective Price’. / 6. Effects also require at the time of ‘Shipping Bill’ & ‘Shipment Plan’-Need to discuss with Shahi Team/Logistic Team, As discussed with ‘Sanjeev Ji’ take impact on Shipment plan, Shipping bill see later because it is integrated.
- validation (§ 5. Acceptance Criteria): Mandatory validation prevents posting without commission details.
- definition (§ 5. Acceptance Criteria): Discount Definition is successfully maintained in the Buyer Master based on Category, Buyer Department, Product Group, and Sub Category.
- definition (§ 5. Acceptance Criteria): Only applicable and Active Discount Definitions are displayed in the Sales Order based on the selected Buyer, Buyer Department, Product Group, and Sub Category.
- definition (§ 5. Acceptance Criteria): Discount Definitions are displayed in the format Discount Name (Discount %).
- definition (§ 5. Acceptance Criteria): The Discount Percentage is automatically calculated as the sum of all selected Discount Definitions and remains read-only.
- formula (§ 5. Acceptance Criteria): The Discount Percentage is automatically calculated as the sum of all selected Discount Definitions and remains read-only.
- definition (§ 5. Acceptance Criteria): The Effective Selling Price is automatically calculated based on the Selling Price and total Discount Percentage and remains read-only.
- definition (§ 5. Acceptance Criteria): Discount Percentage and Effective Selling Price are displayed correctly across all supported Price Per options (Article, Color, Size, and Color/Size).
- definition (§ 5. Acceptance Criteria): The Total Value is calculated using the Effective Selling Price.
- definition (§ 5. Acceptance Criteria): Duplicate Discount Names are not allowed within the same Discount Definition in Buyer Master.
- validation (§ 5. Acceptance Criteria): Duplicate Discount Names are not allowed within the same Discount Definition in Buyer Master.
- validation (§ 5. Acceptance Criteria): Users without the "Allow to Revise Discount Definition in Sales Order" permission cannot modify the Discount Definition through UI, EDI, LLM, or other integrations.
- definition (§ 5. Acceptance Criteria): If Approval Hierarchy is enabled, any revision that changes the Effective Selling Price is routed for approval before the changes become effective.
- validation (§ 5. Acceptance Criteria): Discount Definition cannot be revised once the Sales Order has been partially or fully dispatched.
- workflow_steps (§ 5. Acceptance Criteria): 5. Acceptance Criteria: / 1. Single commission definition auto-populates successfully. / 2. Multiple commission definitions required manual selection. / 3. No commission definition follows existing behaviour. / 4. FA Setting disabled – feature inactive. / 5. Mandatory validation prevents posting without commission details. / 6. Users with bypass permission can edit or skip commission details. / 7. Accounting entries and Credit Note generation remain unchanged. / 8. Discount Definition is successfully maintained in the Buyer Master based on Category, Buyer Department, Product Group, and Sub Category. / 9. Only applicable and Active Discount Definitions are displayed in the Sales Order based on the selected Buyer, Buyer Department, Product Group, and Sub Category. / 10. Users can select multiple Discount Definitions using the multi-select checkbox control. / 11. Discount Definitions are displayed in the format Discount Name (Discount %). / 12. The Discount Percentage is automatically calculated as the sum of all selected Discount Definitions and remains read-only. / 13. The Effective Selling Price is automatically calculated based on the Selling Price and total Discount Percentage and remains read-only. / 14. Discount Percentage and Effective Selling Price are displayed correctly across all supported Price Per options (Article, Color, Size, and Color/Size). / 15. The Total Value is calculated using the Effective Selling Price. / 16. Duplicate Discount Names are not allowed within the same Discount Definition in Buyer Master. / 17. Only one Discount can be marked as the Default within a Discount Definition. / 18. Users without the "Allow to Revise Discount Definition in Sales Order" permission cannot modify the Discount Definition through UI, EDI, LLM, or other integrations. / 19. Users with the "Allow to Revise Discount Definition in Sales Order" permission can modify the Discount Definition during Sales Order revision. / 20. If Approval Hierarchy is enabled, any revision that changes the Effective Selling Price is routed for approval before the changes become effective. / 21. Discount Definition cannot be revised once the Sales Order has been partially or fully dispatched. / 22. Discount Definition, Discount Percentage, and Effective Selling Price are displayed correctly in all applicable screens, including Sales Order, Quantity Breakup, Update Order Confirmation, EDI Buyer PO, and Color/Size Detail. / 23. Existing Sales Order processing, dispatch, invoicing, accounting, and financial postings remain unaffected by this enhancement.
